description: Phase 5 — real voluntary focus session UX layered on the existing Phase 1 native module, with a pure clock-injected session domain tested without a device. Independent of FEAT-002. Reuses getFocusAvailability() as the single honesty truth and the native GoalieFocusApi (presentActivityPicker/getSelection/startFocusSession[schedules-before-shields]/stopFocusSession[emergency release]/getActiveSession[authoritative reconciliation]). Never fakes a blocked/active state and never simulates shields with a JS timer; the deadline/native release is the only source of the block, which NEVER creates learning credit and learning completion NEVER depends on the timer.
steps: Create src/domain/focus-session/index.ts (pure TS; no react/react-native/AsyncStorage/Node-IO imports; mirror the style of src/domain/rewards). Export: FocusSessionRecord { id: string; deadlineEpochMs: number; selectionSummary: string }; type FocusPhase = 'idle'|'active'|'expired'|'released'; interface FocusClock { nowEpochMs(): number }; constants MIN_DURATION_SECONDS=60, MAX_DURATION_SECONDS=86400; class FocusSessionError extends Error (mirror ProgressionError). Pure fns: validateDuration(seconds): {ok:true}|{ok:false; reason:string} enforcing Number.isInteger and [60,86400]; phaseOf(record: FocusSessionRecord|null, nowEpochMs: number): FocusPhase (null->'idle'; now<deadline->'active'; now>=deadline->'expired'); remainingSeconds(record, nowEpochMs): number clamped at 0; reconcile(local: FocusSessionRecord|null, native: FocusSessionRecord|null, nowEpochMs): { record: FocusSessionRecord|null; phase: FocusPhase } preferring the native (app-group) record when present (authoritative), returning idle when both absent, and yielding 'expired' when nowEpochMs is at/after the deadline even if the device clock jumped far forward (never extend a block).

Add __tests__/focus-session.test.ts with a FakeClock implementing FocusClock: normal start->active->expiry across the injected deadline; remainingSeconds clamps to 0 after expiry; validateDuration rejects 59, 86401, 60.5, NaN and accepts 60 and 86400; phaseOf null->idle; reconcile prefers native over a stale local record, returns idle when both null, and returns expired for a clock at or far beyond the deadline (device-clock-change); a second start while a record exists is rejected at the domain level (model the native E_SESSION_ACTIVE idempotency).

Modify src/persistence/store.ts to carry an optional focusSession: FocusSessionRecord|null inside the existing single-key 'goalie.v1' document. Extend the structural guard to accept missing/null or a well-shaped record (id non-empty string, deadlineEpochMs finite number, selectionSummary string); a malformed focusSession is dropped to null with exactly one console.warn (reuse the existing warn style). Default to null in defaultPersistedData(). Do NOT change STORAGE_KEY and do NOT regress existing load/migrate behavior. Import FocusSessionRecord from the domain so the store stays the only AsyncStorage importer.

Add cases to __tests__/store.test.ts: round-trips a focusSession record; a document whose focusSession is malformed loads with it dropped to null plus one warn while authoritative fields are preserved; absence defaults to null.
Add src/ui/focus/focusClock.ts exporting focusClock: FocusClock = { nowEpochMs: () => Date.now() } (UI layer; domain sees only the interface).

Add src/ui/focus/useFocusSession.ts: a hook that calls getFocusAvailability() once and exposes the honest verdict; when available exposes presentPicker() (catch FocusCancelledError -> clean no-op, no error state), selectionSummary (from getSelection()), start(durationSeconds) (validateDuration first; call native startFocusSession; on reject surface the native error code honestly and DO NOT enter an active UI state — mirrors 'if scheduling fails, do not start protection'), emergencyRelease() (call stopFocusSession, always available while active, then clear the local mirror), and derived phase/remainingSeconds computed from reconcile(localMirror, await getActiveSession(), focusClock.nowEpochMs()). Persist/clear the local mirror through ProgressionProvider (add a setter on the context if needed, single-key saveData path). A display-only ticking of remainingSeconds is allowed but must never be the source of release.

If the hook needs to persist the focus mirror, add a minimal setFocusSession(record: FocusSessionRecord|null): Promise<void> to src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx that writes through the existing persist()/saveData single-key path and exposes focusSession on the context. Do not change unrelated provider behavior.

Rewrite src/ui/screens/FocusScreen.tsx to use useFocusSession: when unavailable, render the existing REASON_TEXT copy and nothing resembling active/blocked (the screens.smoke.test contract must still pass: contains 'unavailable', shows a REASON_TEXT string, and does NOT contain 'blocked'/'blocking'/'session active' as fabricated state); when available, render the flow — pick apps (FamilyActivityPicker via native), choose a duration validated to [60s,86400s], an explicit disclosure block stating exactly what will be blocked, that the block releases automatically at the disclosed deadline regardless of lesson/quiz state, and that it can be ended anytime via emergency release, then an explicit Start focus button; while active show the honest native status, remainingSeconds, and an always-visible Emergency release; reconcile on mount. State the compile-only limitation inline; never claim unbreakable blocking.

Add a FocusScreen available-path test (extend __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx or add __tests__/focus-screen.test.tsx) mocking getFocusAvailability -> {available:true} and the GoalieFocus surface (presentActivityPicker/getSelection/startFocusSession/stopFocusSession/getActiveSession): assert the disclosure text renders before any Start affordance; Start is gated on a valid selection + valid duration; a startFocusSession rejection leaves the UI non-active with an honest error (no fabricated block); an active reconciled session (getActiveSession returns a record with a future deadline) shows remaining time and emergency release; emergencyRelease calls stopFocusSession and returns to idle. Keep the real-host honest-unavailable assertions intact.
acceptance_criteria: src/domain/focus-session/index.ts is pure (npx tsc --noEmit passes; no react/react-native/AsyncStorage import) and all behaviors are covered by __tests__/focus-session.test.ts.
`npx jest focus-session` passes and `npx jest store` passes (including the new focusSession mirror cases).
The focus flow enforces duration bounds [60,86400], shows an explicit disclosure before Start, and on a native startFocusSession rejection never enters an active/blocked UI state.
On the jest host (non-iOS) FocusScreen shows the honest unavailable verdict and never a fabricated blocked/active/session-active state: `npx jest screens.smoke` passes.
The available-path test proves reconcile-driven active state + working emergency release using a mocked native surface, with no real native call.
No Swift file under modules/goalie-focus/ios or ios-extensions is modified.
verification: npx jest screens.smoke  (passes; honest-unavailable contract holds)
npm run lint  (clean; no unused imports)
findings: New files: src/domain/focus-session/index.ts (pure domain: FocusSessionRecord{id,deadlineEpochMs,selectionSummary}, FocusPhase 'idle'|'active'|'expired'|'released', FocusClock{nowEpochMs()}, MIN_DURATION_SECONDS=60, MAX_DURATION_SECONDS=86400, FocusSessionError, and pure fns validateDuration/phaseOf/remainingSeconds/reconcile plus assertCanStart(record,now) which throws FocusSessionError on an already-active record to model native E_SESSION_ACTIVE). src/ui/focus/focusClock.ts (focusClock: FocusClock = { nowEpochMs: () => Date.now() }). src/ui/focus/useFocusSession.ts (hook: one-time getFocusAvailability() verdict; when available exposes presentPicker (FocusCancelledError -> clean no-op), selectionSummary from getSelection(), start(durationSeconds) that validates then calls native startFocusSession and on reject sets startError WITHOUT entering an active state, emergencyRelease() that calls stopFocusSession then clears the mirror, and derived phase/remainingSeconds from reconcile(localMirror, getActiveSession(), focusClock.nowEpochMs()); a display-only 1s tick re-renders remainingSeconds but never ends the block). Tests: __tests__/focus-session.test.ts, __tests__/focus-screen.test.tsx; store cases added to __tests__/store.test.ts. ProgressionProvider context additions (for FEAT-002/FEAT-003): context now exposes focusSession: FocusSessionRecord|null and setFocusSession(record: FocusSessionRecord|null): Promise<void> which persists through the existing single-key saveData path. Store: PersistedData gained focusSession: FocusSessionRecord|null (defaults null in defaultPersistedData); guardV2 drops a malformed focusSession to null with exactly one warn 'goalie: dropped malformed focus session' (accepts absent/null or a record with non-empty string id, finite deadlineEpochMs, string selectionSummary); STORAGE_KEY unchanged; FocusSessionRecord imported from the domain so the store stays the only AsyncStorage importer. Focus-session mirror shape == native FocusSession shape (id/deadlineEpochMs/selectionSummary). Reconcile prefers the native (app-group) record as authoritative; FocusScreen reconciles on mount and renders honest unavailable copy (REASON_TEXT) on non-iOS and the full pick/duration/disclosure/start + active/emergency-release flow when available, stating the compile-only ceiling inline. NOTE: this worktree carried pre-existing uncommitted Phase 3/4 UI integration (ProgressionProvider rewards/coaching wiring, src/ui/rewards/systemClock.ts, MasteryResultScreen/ResultScreen/ProgressScreen/PracticeScreen/RootNavigator); the FEAT-001 commit includes only the focus files plus the ProgressionProvider + systemClock needed for a coherent compile, leaving the unrelated Phase 3/4 screen changes unstaged.
